lines: Having deposited up to prakṛti, again he should perform the rite by the great-net-practice, from the middle of all the paths.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ
